name: Loupe & Lettres — Normalize statement CSV (synthetic profiles)

parameters.content:
## Loupe & Lettres — créé avec l'aide de l'IA

### How it works
This manual workflow helps freelancers turn a pasted bank statement CSV into consistent transaction JSON. It validates the selected demonstration profile, calendar dates, signed amounts and currency. Amounts use integer minor units. Totals remain separated by currency. Identical date, label, amount and currency combinations are flagged as possible duplicates and preserved, because two genuine transactions can look identical. No email is sent, no bank is contacted and no external account is required.

### Setup
Import this JSON into a fresh workflow. Open “Example statement” and keep the synthetic Qonto-inspired sample for your first run. Execute the workflow manually and inspect “Normalize statement”. Compare the output with the supplied example. To process another example, choose qonto, boursorama, revolut_business or credit_agricole and paste its CSV text into csv. These are synthetic demonstration layouts; real bank exports have not been verified. Dates, separators and required columns must match the supplied fixtures. Only EUR, USD, GBP and CHF are accepted.

### Customization
Adapt the field mappings in the Code node only after testing your own export. Review every possible duplicate before reconciliation. This tool prepares data; it does not provide accounting or tax advice.

## Manual input
Use the included synthetic statement first. Replace profile and csv in Example statement.

## Validate and inspect
Invalid rows stop the run. Possible duplicates remain in the output for review.
